title: Cardinal Roadside Assistance Endorsement: Covered Services and Dispatch
content:
## A. Coverage grant

When the scheduled vehicle is disabled, Cardinal dispatches a provider to that vehicle, whoever is driving it with permission. Service is requested through the Cardinal mobile app or by phone; these are the two dispatch channels on every Cardinal Roadside Assistance option.

The covered services are those switched on for the vehicle's option:

1. **Tow**, up to the tow miles the option pays per service call, to the destination the option's tow destination term allows, with the number of tows per breakdown the option pays;
2. **Jump start**;
3. **Battery testing and installation labor**, where the option includes battery service labor;
4. **Lockout**: door opening, and a locksmith up to the option's locksmith limit;
5. **Flat tire change** with a usable spare; without one, where the option requires a usable spare, the vehicle is towed as a tow call;
6. **Fuel delivery** of up to the option's most gallons per call;
7. **Winch-out** within the option's winch-out distance of a public road;
8. **Mechanical first aid**, where switched on for the option;
9. **Motorhome or attached trailer service**, up to the option's heaviest gross vehicle weight rating, only on an option that services motorhomes and trailers.

The tow miles, locksmith limit and fuel gallons applied are those of the option on the vehicle, read from that option's own schedule.

## B. Services never covered

Off-road recovery, tows from a police impound, storage and replacement keys are never covered, under any Cardinal Roadside Assistance option.

## C. Arrival target

Providers aim to arrive within the response target from dispatch to arrival:

| Option | Response target from dispatch to provider arrival | Dispatch channels |
|---|---|---|
| Cardinal Roadside Basic | 60 minutes | Mobile app, phone |
| Cardinal Roadside Standard | 60 minutes | Mobile app, phone |
| Cardinal Roadside Plus | 45 minutes | Mobile app, phone |
| Cardinal Roadside Plus with Trip Interruption | 45 minutes | Mobile app, phone |
| Cardinal Roadside Premier | 45 minutes | Mobile app, phone |
| Cardinal Roadside Premier RV & Trailer | 45 minutes | Mobile app, phone |

The response target is an aim for arrival, stated in minutes after dispatch.

## D. Questions on the grant

**Is the named insured the only person who can get service?** No. Service goes to the scheduled vehicle whoever is driving it with permission.

**Is a lockout always limited to opening the door?** Door opening is covered on every option with lockout service; a locksmith is paid up to the option's locksmith limit, and where that limit is nothing, the service is door opening only.

**A vehicle with a flat tire has no usable spare. What is covered?** Where the option requires a usable spare, the vehicle is towed as a tow call.

**Can the vehicle be recovered from a lake or an off-road trail?** No. Off-road recovery is never covered.

**Is a tow out of a police impound covered?** No. Impound tows are never covered.

## E. Hypothetical illustration

A member on Cardinal Roadside Plus calls by phone after a lockout. A provider is dispatched to the scheduled vehicle with a 45-minute arrival aim, opens the door, and any locksmith work is paid up to the Cardinal Roadside Plus locksmith limit. The call channel, the service and the option are illustrative.
